FINAL SQL:
SELECT AirportCode
FROM airports
WHERE AirportCode = (
    SELECT AirportCode
    FROM (
        SELECT a.AirportCode,
               (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flights f WHERE f.SourceAirport = a.AirportCode) +
               (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flights f WHERE f.DestAirport = a.AirportCode) AS total_flights
        FROM airports a
    )
    ORDER BY total_flights ASC
    LIMIT 1
);
